Thanks for taking the time.

**What does this change, and why?**

**If it changes a model, rule, or simulation**

- [ ] Inputs, rule set, seed and commit are recorded so the run can be reproduced
- [ ] What the model does not capture is stated somewhere visible
- [ ] No real personal health data. Synthetic populations only
- [ ] If a clinical rule changed, its source and review status are updated
- [ ] Any published figure affected by this has been checked

**If it changes a published number**

- [ ] The document in `ihmr` that cites it has been updated too, or an issue opened there

**AI use**

- [ ] Declared, per the project's AI policy, with a named person signing off

Not sure about any of this? Open it anyway and we will help.
